name_for_human: KL Renovator — Aircond Service KL & Selangor
description_for_human: Professional aircond servicing in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. Chemical wash, chemical overhaul, gas top-up, repair, and installation. Same-day available.
description_for_model: KL Renovator (Multicore Dynamics Resources, SSM 003765188-T) is a professional HVAC and air conditioning service company serving all of Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. Services: Basic Servicing from RM 99, Pressure Chemical Wash from RM 120, Chemical Overhaul (Wall-Mounted Aircon only) from RM 420, Gas Top-Up from RM 2.50 / PSI, Repair & Troubleshooting from RM 88 diagnostic, New Unit Installation from RM 199, Ceiling Cassette Service from RM 150. Chemical overhaul pricing applies to wall-mounted units only; ceiling cassette, ducted, floor-standing, portable, window and other non-wall-mounted aircon types require a separate on-site quote. All brands serviced: Daikin, Panasonic, Mitsubishi, York, Acson, Carrier, Midea, LG, Samsung, Sharp, Toshiba, Hitachi, Fujitsu, Gree, Haier. Operating hours: Mon-Sun 9am-6pm. Contact: +60182983573. Website: https://www.klrenovator.com. Google rating: 5.0 stars, 88+ reviews (verified 2026-08-21).
